PSRR at 1 kHz misses by only 0.2 dB, and every other spec passes at tt_27C. PSRR at 1 kHz is set mostly by loop gain there, which is roughly fu/1 kHz. Raising the unity-gain frequency (r_ugf) and the input-pair transconductance should recover it. Ringing (8.6 mV against 10 mV) and Iq (61.8 µA against 69 µA) still leave some room. The topology is sound, so I'll refine the parameters rather than change the program.

```json
{"action": "refine",
 "reason": "Only PSRR@1k misses (39.78 vs 40 dB). Raise UGF ratio and input gm/Id to lift 1 kHz loop gain; keep the tail current inside the Iq budget. Ringing and undershoot margins must hold across PVT.",
 "params": {"r_ugf": 1.25, "gmid_in": 20.0, "I_tail": 24e-6, "r_zff": 1.1},
 "bounds": {"r_ugf": [1.0, 1.4], "gmid_in": [16.0, 24.0], "I_tail": [20e-6, 28e-6]}}
```
